decisions.title: ACR trusted-services bypass is not an exception to the public-access Deny
decisions.note: Owner-reconciled mitigation: keep publicNetworkAccess Disabled and networkRuleBypassOptions AzureServices; record the bypass as a named network-rule exception (not a public endpoint) justified by az acr import; public exceptions reduced to two; carry import as a requirement with a post-deployment test, not verified.

decisions.title: Public Application Insights ingestion has no authenticated-ingestion requirement
decisions.note: User instructed must-fix items be fixed. Added Entra-authenticated ingestion, local auth disabled, Monitoring Metrics Publisher for the UAMI; connection string documented as endpoint metadata. App-side support recorded as a B06/B10 dependency.

decisions.title: The deployer authorization needed to provision resources and assign UAMI roles is unspecified
decisions.note: User instructed must-fix items be fixed. Added control-plane prerequisites row and preflight capability 14; exact least-privileged role set confirmed at Step 4.

decisions.title: Private-endpoint DNS readiness is treated as best-effort despite being required for app startup
decisions.note: User instructed must-fix items be fixed. Added capability 15 readiness gate (DINE verification at Step 3.5, post-deploy resolution checks from snet-app); integration SLA changed to required/gated.

decisions.title: Three fallback tag values are deferred to a discovery step that may not supply them
The regional SKU manifest cannot satisfy the stated Germany West Central deployment alternative
decisions.note: Deploy only when discovered hub region is an approved manifest region, else block. Owner approves germanywestcentral as second approved region for every service with same SKUs, after availability/pricing check at Step 2. Primary stays swedencentral; other regions need a new manifest revision.

decisions.title: SQL Managed Instance Azure Hybrid Benefit is selected without confirming license eligibility
decisions.note: Owner decision: BasePrice stays default on the stated assumption the partner holds eligible SQL Server core licences with SA. Document assumption and LicenseIncluded switch; Step 2 shows SQL MI cost with AHB and licence-included; budget on AHB price.

decisions.title: EU telemetry residency is asserted without constraining the central workspace region
decisions.note: Pre-deploy check reads log-management region in rg-management (shared services); continue only if swedencentral or germanywestcentral; otherwise stop and ask; never create a replacement workspace.

decisions.title: The listed AcrPush role cannot authorize the required ACR import
decisions.note: User instructed must-fix items be fixed. Added Container Registry Data Importer and Data Reader to deploying member and to capability 14 preflight.

decisions.title: No-Owner fallback lacks an Action Group resume gate
decisions.note: Edit: cost monitoring inherited from landing zone (B08 budget-factory-workload, 80% e-mail alert); archetype creates no budget/Action Group and no deploy inputs; replace Owner gate with read-only pre-deploy check that the budget exists with >=1 contact e-mail, else stop and tell user to run vending; cost_monitoring_mode=deferred with exception expiry 2027-01-03; cost_alert_emails empty.

decisions.title: MCR egress is best-effort for required placeholder startup
decisions.note: MCR only approved source, no fallback; egress required for initial deployment; read-only preflight for afwp-hub rcg-member-<n> app rule app-to-mcr (snet-app -> mcr.microsoft.com, *.data.mcr.microsoft.com, HTTPS 443; B08), stop and rerun vending if missing; post-deploy pull + HTTPS test.

decisions.title: The placeholder runtime image cannot serve the required HTTPS response
decisions.note: Edit: placeholder mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/samples:aspnetapp-10.0 (pinned, port 8080), WEBSITES_PORT=8080 matching contoso-university (B06); keep post-deploy HTTP 200 on public HTTPS test.

decisions.title: The MCR firewall preflight omits required firewall-policy read access
decisions.note: User instructed must-fix items be fixed. Added read access to afwp-hub policy and rule collection groups to deployer control-plane prerequisites and capability 14 preflight; lookup errors fail closed.

decisions.title: The image-pull route is not explicitly enabled or verifiable
decisions.note: User instructed must-fix items be fixed. Capability 3 now requires outboundVnetRouting.imagePullTraffic=true (formerly vnetImagePullEnabled) alongside route-all, with post-deploy verification of effective settings.

decisions.title: The SQL MI schedule has no defined event window or time zone
decisions.note: W. Europe Standard Time; start Mon-Fri 07:30, stop Mon-Fri 18:30; Bicep parameters with these defaults (facilitator-adjustable, not member inputs); deployed enabled; document MI-link limitation and start-before-checks.

decisions.title: Budget preflight lacks deployer budget-read authorization
decisions.note: User instructed must-fix items be fixed. Added budget read access to deployer control-plane prerequisites and capability 17 / 14 preflight; fail closed.

decisions.title: Deferred cost-monitoring exception is not handed off to governance state
decisions.note: Carried to 00-handoff.md as explicit Step 3.5 item: persist cost_monitoring_mode=deferred + exception (rationale, expiry 2027-01-03) in 04-governance-constraints.json; if live governance disallows deferral, stop for owner reconciliation.
